echo_sets.name: Shadow of Shattered Dreams + Void Thunder + Reel of Spliced Memories
echo_sets.note: The triple-Sonata setup made for the collab. The 1-pc set grants Basic and Heavy Attack DMG whenever Rebecca applies Hack - Shifting. The 2-pc pieces add Electro DMG +10% and ATK +10% (Lingering Tunes can replace Reel of Spliced Memories). Adam Smasher gives her a unique effect and Crit Rate.

echo_sets.name: Moonlit Clouds
echo_sets.note: Buffs her general sub-DPS damage and gives the next Resonator an ATK buff. A strong pick alongside any DPS.

echo_sets.name: Void Thunder
echo_sets.note: Heavy Electro DMG buffs. A workable early-game option, but weaker than the triple-Sonata setup.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Skull Thrasher + 1-pc Shadow of Shattered Dreams / 2-pc Void Thunder / 2-pc ATK set in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Reminiscence: Nightmare Adam Smasher in the main slot. Stack Crit and Electro DMG on the 4-cost and 3-costs. Use ATK% on the 1-costs. Aim for roughly 125% Energy Regen, so her Resonance Liberation is ready each rotation.

ranked_weapons.name: Skull Thrasher
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature (some guides call it 'Bone Crusher'). It has 500 base ATK and a 72% Crit DMG substat. Its skill adds Basic Attack DMG. It also gives the whole team an ATK buff for 30s when Hack - Shifting is inflicted. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Phasic Homogenizer
ranked_weapons.note: One of the best standard 5-star pistols. It has high base ATK and Crit DMG, an ATK buff passive that is always on, and All-Attribute DMG Bonus on Tune Break.

ranked_weapons.name: Spectrum Blaster
ranked_weapons.note: High base ATK, Crit Rate substat, unconditional ATK passive, and a Basic Attack DMG increase for the wielder.

ranked_weapons.name: Static Mist
ranked_weapons.note: Sub-DPS pistol: Crit Rate, extra Energy Regen, and a passive that buffs the next Resonator's ATK.

ranked_weapons.name: Novaburst
ranked_weapons.note: An ATK-based 4-star. It gives an easy 12% ATK buff, triggered by dashing or dodging.

ranked_weapons.name: Pistols#26
ranked_weapons.note: An ATK-based 4-star. It grants ATK while she takes no damage, and heals her when she is hit.

ranked_weapons.name: Relativistic Jet
ranked_weapons.note: An ATK-based 4-star. Extra ATK and Resonance Energy make her rotations smoother.

stat_priorities.note: Pick whichever balances her Crit ratio; Adam Smasher already grants Crit Rate.
ATK% on both; her kit scales with ATK.

profile.role_note: A hybrid sub-DPS and buffer. She swaps between Huntress (Crit DMG) and Guts (DEF-ignore) stances. Her Outro turret hands the next Resonator All-DMG buffs plus stacking Heavy Attack DMG buffs.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: There is nothing to pull for. Rebecca was the free 5-star from the 3.4 Cyberpunk: Edgerunners collab, and collab characters rarely rerun. Game8 notes her reruns are expected to be rarer than other limited units. If you claimed her during the event, she is an excellent free investment — a top-tier sub-DPS who buffs any Heavy Attack DPS. If you missed her, there is no confirmed way to get her right now. Do not hold resources waiting for her.

members.name: Lucy
members.note: The main damage dealer; multiple debuffs, time-stop burst, and she upgrades Rebecca's turret via the Hack - Shifting synergy.

members.name: Rebecca
members.note: Off-field turret from her Outro plus All-DMG and Heavy Attack DMG buffs for whoever swaps in next.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Boosts Off-Tune efficiency so Tune Break triggers more often, while providing All-DMG Amplification to the team. Shorekeeper or Verina can substitute.

teams.name: Premium: Lucy + Rebecca + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye opens with Basic Attacks and her Resonance Skill. Then she casts Liberation to deploy High Syntony Field. Switch to Rebecca through the Outro. Run three Basic Attacks in Guts stance. Swap to Huntress with her Resonance Skill. Build to max Forte and land an empowered Heavy Attack. Then cast Liberation — press it twice more to upgrade it. Finally, swap to Lucy for her burst combo, then loop back to Mornye.

members.name: Jingran
members.note: One of the strongest Heavy Attack carries; easy rotations let him convert Rebecca's buffs into huge numbers.

members.name: Rebecca
members.note: Quick Concerto generation, Liberation time-stop with Stagnation, and Outro buffs that suit any Heavy Attack DPS.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit and damage buffs plus healing; barely needs field time.

teams.name: Alternative: Jingran + Rebecca + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper builds her gauges and deploys Stellarealm. Then she Outros into Rebecca. Rebecca runs three Basic Attacks in Guts stance. She uses her Resonance Skill to swap into Huntress. She lands two more Basic Attacks and an empowered Heavy Attack. Then she casts Liberation — press it twice more to upgrade it. Outro to Jingran for his full Liberation and Heavy Attack combo, then loop.

tier_badge.label: Top-tier sub-DPS
